dataList.name: Rival Candidate
dataList.desc: +10% sát thương gây ra against Hồng Lộ

dataList.name: Shi(史) Family Charge Circuitry
dataList.desc:
Nhận 1 [Charge] every time this unit consumes 10 cumulative Tầng [Charge] in this Encounter
Cuối Lượt: Ở mốc 2+ [Charge], nhận 1 [ParryingResultUp] vào lượt kế

dataList.name: Charge Circuitry Activation
dataList.desc: +5% sát thương gây ra for every 6 [Burst] on target (tối đa 10%)

dataList.name: Overload
dataList.desc: Cuối Lượt: at 3+ [Charge], nhận 3 [DefenseDown] và 1 [AttackDmgUp] vào lượt kế

dataList.name: Severe Overload
dataList.desc: Cuối Lượt: at 5+ [Charge], nhận 4 [DefenseDown] và 3 [AttackDmgUp] vào lượt kế

dataList.name: Experiment Goal - Maturation
dataList.desc:
Đầu Lượt: nhận [DefenseUp] equal to (number of times this unit was hit by the enemies' Skill Attacks / 2) (tối đa 10)

Lose this effect when Staggered for the first time; then, at the next Turn Start, nhận 10 [DefenseDown]

dataList.name: Experiment Goal - Germination
dataList.desc:
Đầu Lượt: if this unit isn't at max HP, hồi 80% of the missing HP
- With every healing, halve the healing effect of this Passive by half (halves down to 10% minimum; applies only when this unit hồi more than 1 HP)
- Does not activate when Staggered

After this unit is Staggered for the first time, or when the healing effect is reduced to its minimum, nhận 3 [Vulnerable] at every Turn Start

dataList.name: Experiment Goal - Blossom
dataList.desc:
When this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, and maintain this unit's HP at 1 until the vào lượt kế; +50% sát thương gây ra (once per Encounter)

Does not activate when Staggered

dataList.name: Talisman Sorcerer
dataList.desc:
Whenever this unit inflicts [OminousTalisman] against an enemy, mất 10 SP

Against targets with [OminousTalisman], +(0 - SP on self)% sát thương gây ra (max 30%, min 0%)

dataList.name: Proliferating Misfortune
dataList.desc:
On death, gán 10 [OminousTalisman] against a random enemy without [OminousTalisman]
- If all enemies already have [OminousTalisman], then reduce all enemies' [OminousTalisman] by 1 instead

dataList.name: Wicked Energy
dataList.desc: When inflicting [OminousTalisman] on an enemy, if the target already has [OminousTalisman], consume 1~2 [OminousTalisman] trên mục tiêu and inflict the same value as [DefenseDown] Stacks to the target this turn and vào lượt kế

dataList.name: Skilled Talisman Sorcerer
dataList.desc:
Whenever this unit inflicts [OminousTalisman] against an enemy, mất 10 SP

Against targets with [OminousTalisman], +(10 - SP on self)% sát thương gây ra (max 50%, min 0%)

dataList.name: Soul Siphon Technique
dataList.desc: Đầu Lượt: at 50% or less HP, sacrifice a random Wicked Deathrite Monk to hồi (10% of this unit's HP + 50% of the sacrificed unit's HP) HP, hồi 25 SP, and recover from Stagger (một lần mỗi lượt)

dataList.name: Wicked Energy
dataList.desc: When inflicting [OminousTalisman] on an enemy, if the target already has [OminousTalisman], consume up to 3 [OminousTalisman] trên mục tiêu and inflict the same value as [DefenseDown] Stacks to the target this turn and vào lượt kế
